_why: How this archive decides who is living and who is held out of the build, as David ruled on 16 October 2026 (the living-people standard, version 2). The test itself is kit/tools/living_rule.py; tools/livingset.py only adapts this tree to it. Written by tools/build_site_data.py on every full run. It records RULES AND COUNTS. It never records a person: no id, no name, no place, no date.

The method page reads this file for its counts. tools/livingcheck.py reads it; with the GEDCOM present it also recomputes who is living from the tree, with the kit's rule and without this generator, and refuses the build when the two disagree.
